observations: Photo 0 shows a white sewing machine with a blue and green control panel, a needle and presser foot, and a dial labeled 'LMR'. The brand 'JUKY' and model 'JH 307' are visible on the front right.
Photo 1 shows the top view of the machine, revealing a white motor housing, a white dial, and red thread spool holder. The machine appears to be a straight-stitch sewing machine.
Photo 2 shows the front view of the machine, with the needle and presser foot visible. The base is white with some wear and dirt. The machine is placed on a wooden surface.
All photos have a watermark 'OSMAT TECH SERVICES' and a green wall in the background.
The machine appears to be a manual sewing machine, not a motorized one, based on the visible components and lack of a motor housing in photo 1.
